newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers mixed amid low resid prices.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers mixed amid low resid prices.

text.p: North American bunker prices on the East Coast fell amid weak crude oil and residual prices this week, but the West Coast firmed on tight avails, players said on Tuesday.
On the Gulf Coast, spot Houston 380 CST continued its slide, falling $5 a tonne since last Thursday to between $80 and $81 a tonne.

Values were pushed down by weak residual prices, at $11 to $12, and crude oil, in the $20.00 a barrel range. Very low demand due to ship owners holding out for ever better deals added to the bearish tone.
